opportunities.name: Tomb drain frontliner
opportunities.objective: Use self-Tomb as a timed healing pivot inside sustained combat.
opportunities.mechanic: Self-cast Frozen Tomb creates 2.5 seconds of stasis and an AP heal increased with missing health; it still emits magic dark ice. Rod and Riftmaker support health/AP, Visage enhances received healing and Abyssal serves close magic contact. Ring of Frost and E access create the entry, while Zhonya's can extend safety if used as a separate planned window.
opportunities.requiredState: Need self R ready, nearby enemies held and missing health without lethal pre-cast damage.
opportunities.failure: Stasis alone does not protect allies; enemies can wait beyond the ice and punish the exit.
opportunities.test: Compare healing, damage and escape after a W-self-R sequence at two starting health values.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Enemy-cast Tomb supplies stun rather than the documented self heal/stasis package.

opportunities.name: Frozen zombie chain finisher
opportunities.objective: Seek a first death that turns into delayed area cleanup.
opportunities.mechanic: Iceborn Subjugation creates zombies on nearby champion deaths; they slow, then shatter after four seconds for level damage plus 0.5 AP magic. Shadowflame can improve low-health magic hits and Cryptbloom adds a heal nova on qualifying deaths. Malignance supplies R pressure for the initial victim, with high AP retaining the delayed zombie threat.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a genuine nearby death and living enemies still close when the zombie shatters.
opportunities.failure: No first death means no passive damage; surviving enemies spread before the delay expires.
opportunities.test: Measure first-victim burst and zombie damage separately, including failed chain cases with enemy disengage.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Zombies are not normal attacking pets and cannot be assigned owner attack on-hits without evidence.

ruledOut.reason: Passive damage is a delayed shatter with an AP term, not attack frequency scaling.

unknowns: Zombie item-proc ownership and self-R missing-health multiplier timing require live logs.

builds.name: Tomb drain frontliner
builds.summary: Use self-Tomb as a timed healing pivot inside sustained combat.
builds.goal: Use self-Tomb as a timed healing pivot inside sustained combat.
builds.hypothesis: Self-cast Frozen Tomb creates 2.5 seconds of stasis and an AP heal increased with missing health; it still emits magic dark ice. Rod and Riftmaker support health/AP, Visage enhances received healing and Abyssal serves close magic contact. Ring of Frost and E access create the entry, while Zhonya's can extend safety if used as a separate planned window.
testPlan: Required state: Need self R ready, nearby enemies held and missing health without lethal pre-cast damage.
Compare healing, damage and escape after a W-self-R sequence at two starting health values.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Stasis alone does not protect allies; enemies can wait beyond the ice and punish the exit.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Enemy-cast Tomb supplies stun rather than the documented self heal/stasis package.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rod of Ages, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Zhonya's Hourglass, Abyssal Mask, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for [1.25 / 1.35 / 1.45 / 1.55 / 1.65] seconds and dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for [1.5] seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for [2.5] seconds and restores [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.55) × AP] Health, increased by [1]% for each [1]% missing Health.

In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. The ice persists for [3] seconds, Slowing enemies by [(-0.45 / -0.6 / -0.75) × -100]%.
Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.

Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage, Slowing them by [(-0.2 / -0.24 / -0.28 / -0.32 / -0.36) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.

When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a frozen zombie that seeks out living enemies. Enemies near these zombies are Slowed by [25]%. After [4] seconds, frozen zombies shatter, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=120, perLevel=20, changes=[{"mLevel": 13, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 30.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.5) × AP] magic damage.
